correctness.rationale: The unit simplex is invariant, i remains positive, and s and d are positive at every positive time even for admissible boundary data (at s=0 the derivative is m; with s,i>0 the source for d is positive). The bound i'<=-mi² and scalar comparison for d imply convergence to (s,i,d)=(1,0,0). If the integral of d were finite, solving the first equation for i would give i~1/(mt), whereas d'+md>=asi with s tending to 1 would force an unbounded integral on the right. Direct independent differentiation gives, for r=i/d² and dτ=d dt, r_τ=r[(m-k)-r(2as+(2k-m)d)] and (log d)_τ=-m+r[as+(k-m)d], equivalent to RESULT.md (2)–(3). The quadratic coefficient tends to 2a. Thus for k<m, logistic comparison gives r→(m-k)/(2a); for k=m the reciprocal of r has slope tending to 2a in τ. The d equation then yields the stated limits of td and, in the marginal case, τ~(log t)/m, giving the exact physical-time infected constants. For k>m the exponentially decaying r makes both logarithmic corrections integrable, yielding positive finite limits R=lim r e^{(k-m)τ} and D=lim d e^{mτ}, and t~e^{mτ}/(mD). For example, starting the clock at zero with fixed d(0)>0 gives R<=i(0)/d(0)² and D>=d(0), so the positive physical-time amplitude is at most m^(-p)i(0)d(0)^(-p) for p=1+k/m; hence it cannot be universal. The checks are analytic and specific to the frozen ODE and its initial-data domain. The supplied verify.py and requirements.txt were inspected but not executed; finite trajectory diagnostics would not establish the limits, and the frozen metadata records no formal verification or expert attestation.

value.rationale: The critical surface is determined by coincident transitions in a published dynamical model, not an arbitrary parameter slice. It supports distinct long-time laws even though the limiting state is the same. The quantitative borderline between universal quadratic relaxation and an initial-data-dependent power law is scientifically useful; the theorem does not extrapolate to stochastic networks or claim empirical validity of the compartments.
